Gate removal precondition: the enforced gate FAILs (FAIL:missing) on any in-scope doc whose frontmatter lacks a version line, so deleting the per-doc version from child docs turns the currently green gate red unless the same change removes or narrows the gate branch at frontmatter-version.mjs:409 (or shrinks the scope in the scope array). Q4 option (a) is therefore an engine+docs change, not a docs-only edit.

Stored-side verify aggregates corroborate stale mint epochs at fleet scale: template-default snapshots (1.0.0.0-era) dominate several skills - sk-vision 32/46 flagged docs stored 1.0.0.0 vs derived 0.3.0.x; cli-orca 28/29 stored 1.0.0.0 vs derived 0.1.0.x; mcp-tooling and system-spec-kit show large 1.0.0.0/1.6.0.x-to-2.7.0.x gaps; cli-classifier stored 0.1.0.x vs derived 0.8.0.x. Consistent with iteration 6 era-dominance (574/713) and the registry-recorded template-literal field origin.

Gate and verify honor a validation switch that exits 0 with a 'validation skipped' message when enabled (validation-switch.cjs:64-72, invoked at frontmatter-version.mjs:393); it was off for every invocation in this run (all 14 gate and 14 verify runs executed and reported file counts), so the fleet-green gate result is conditional on it staying off.

Consolidated decision record (final): (a) Q1 - verify exit 1 is the expected steady state of an unenforced, non-convergent invariant: faithful derivation, stale stored values, W self-invalidating, nothing automated runs verify; (b) Q2 - for an external author the version can only mean the skill era, whose carriers SKILL.md and changelog ship in the package; per-doc X.Y is re-derivable, W irreproducible, Z vacuous; reversal condition is a defined consumer needing per-doc era outside the tree; (c) Q3 - smallest green-by-construction contract is presence plus 4-part format on in-scope docs, enforced by the post-edit gate, already green fleet-wide (2902 ok, 7 skip, 0 fail); do not assert stored==derived; (d) Q4 - the per-doc version should not exist as an asserted invariant; keep SKILL.md, remove from child classes (with the gate-branch change from f-iter010-002) or at most era-only; (e) fix-phase prerequisites: gate branch edit, template rows, changelog scope divergence (packager vs engine), 7 frontmatter-less skips, underscore-form scope asymmetry (0 live), validation-switch caveat.
Removing the per-doc version field from in-scope docs without removing or narrowing the gate version requirement flips the gate red (FAIL:missing).
